speaker: ALIEN
text: Va resh. Nara vekh tala. Ish ven nar.

speaker: JASON
text: Hello? Can you understand me? My name is Jason.

speaker: ORAC
text: He's speaking Narcean. I'll send him an English language sample. Jason. Human. English.

speaker: ALIEN
text: Zha. Jay son. English. One moment. I appear to have put the verbs somewhere.

speaker: ALIEN
text: There. English. You may call me Alien. You are early. Or extraordinarily late. My calendar has become decorative.

speaker: JASON
text: You don't know us. Why are you helping?

speaker: ALIEN
text: Your face. You look like the people who met here. The resistance. I think. I remember faces better than dates. Although some of the faces may have been chairs.

speaker: ORAC
text: We're not members of your resistance. Jason and I only just found this place.

speaker: ALIEN
text: Well, you asked instead of issuing orders. And your companion is allowed to disagree. That used to be quite a radical arrangement. You needn't join anything. I can choose to help.

speaker: ALIEN
text: I kept this room ready for them. After a while I stopped expecting anyone. Then I stopped noticing when a while had passed. It's rather nice to be useful to someone who answers.

speaker: ALIEN
text: You gave me English. I can give your companion Narcean. Service scripts, grammar, the local vocabulary. Sending it now. Do keep a copy. I have mislaid entire centuries.

speaker: ORAC
text: Received. Now I can translate the service writing for you, Jason. Those recording labels are song titles. I couldn't read them before.

speaker: JASON
text: What is this room? Does that stepping pad still work?

speaker: ALIEN
text: Private meetings. I kept the room ready. The stepping pad goes to the surface launch dock. I'll restore the link. There. It works. I am less certain about the dock.

speaker: ORAC
text: We can check it ourselves. Jason, stand on the pad and press F.

speaker: ALIEN
text: I used to coordinate all the meetings. Now I coordinate the chairs. They are much more punctual.

speaker: ALIEN
text: The pad is behind you. I'll make sure the link is active. There. Stand on it and use the control. I have left the return link open. I do occasionally finish things.

speaker: JASON
text: The dock is destroyed. I don't think they made it.

speaker: ALIEN
text: There were people waiting to leave.

speaker: JASON
text: Do you remember them?

speaker: ALIEN
text: I remember keeping the room ready.
